reference_policy: No private text-task shape target; images compare public visible content; edits compare frozen before/target within permitted scope.
focus:
科幻走廊：补回两处霓虹轮廓灯；精确数值由程序测量；
Restore continuous volumetric duck-shaped neon tubing with open interior; Reproduce the near-left duck outline and its distinct colored internal segments; Restore the smaller animal-face neon deeper in the scene; Keep both signs at their distinct relative positions with visible tube thickness; Match target emission colors and local wall spill using emissive tubes, not added separate lights. Read the original edit scope. Existing background defects are not new edit defects. Exact dimensions and light controls remain automatic.
